cadence_window.label: T-90 inactives lock refresh + conformal residual diagnostic (flag-only)

inputs.dossier_root_note: Per-game dossier packet files are hashed below. When dossier_root is set, the packet's dossier_rel_path is re-rooted there by basename, so a regenerated local state can be diagnosed without silently mixing it with the committed state. The primary inputs here were the local 10:21 CT regenerated Week-10 dossiers, which were NOT committed at report time; conformal_baseline recomputes the same band on the origin/main committed dossiers, so the reader can see both without confusing them.

seal.provenance_caveat: candidates/ is quarantined per artifacts/CANONICAL-ENVIRONMENT-2026-10-27.md D1: the parent seal hash is documented as sequential hex. 'unchanged' asserts byte-identity with the active seal center, not that the seal is independently reproducible.

no_mutation.note: This run wrote exactly one file: this report. candidates/, dossiers and every sealed artifact were opened read-only.

observation_exclusions.exclusion_note: NE @ DET (14:30Z) is in progress at this run's T-90 timestamp, so its ESPN designations are no longer a pre-kickoff lock input. Games at 21:05Z/21:25Z/01:20Z belong to the 13:35 CT SUN_LATE run and the SNF/MNF slots; they are listed here for completeness and are NOT part of this slot's conformal band.

summary.absence_semantics_caveat: A Friday designation that no longer appears in the ESPN summary feed is NOT evidence the player is active: ESPN drops players from the injury list once a designation lapses, and official inactives are published 90 minutes before kickoff, not inside the injury feed. Read stored_names_absent_detail as 'designation resolved or withdrawn, needs owner confirmation', never as 'cleared to play'.
summary.pull_stability_note: Three ESPN pulls across this morning's 10:30-11:00 CT window returned 55, 66 and 69 applied designations on the same seven games, and stored-name absences moved 25 -> 28 -> 35 with wholesale membership changes (a player would appear, disappear and reappear). The summary injuries array is live and re-derived as game status replaces report status, so a single pull is a point-in-time read, NOT a lock record: designation-level diffing needs the official inactives list, and no reprice may key off one pull of this feed.
summary.diff_caveat: Stored side is the Friday v3.0 overlay's applied designations for these games. The T-90 ESPN pull is the full league designation list, so newly_listed names include players the Friday materiality filter never carried — scope difference, not all status flips. The signal that matters is stored_names_absent_from_refresh: curated Friday names no longer Out/Doubtful/Questionable at T-90. A newly-listed name on a sealed ticket is a flag for the owner, never a silent reprice.

conformal.path: single-total; Week-10 packet dossiers persist posted_total plus devigged Over/Under pair, so pOver_model is Stage-5 post_sim_prob and the external total is the posted line
conformal.degeneracy_note: qLevel saturates at 1.0 for n<=18 at alpha=0.1; the band equals max|residual| and no flag is possible by construction. This is a property of the estimator at this sample size, not evidence of calibration.

conformal_baseline.label: origin/main committed week-10 dossiers (comparison band)
conformal_baseline.degeneracy_note: qLevel saturates at 1.0 for n<=18 at alpha=0.1; the band equals max|residual| and no flag is possible by construction. This is a property of the estimator at this sample size, not evidence of calibration.
conformal_baseline.note: Second band computed on the committed dossiers so the day-of regeneration is not silently folded into the primary number. Neither band is a gate: at n=7 both are degenerate at alpha=0.1.

publication.reason: Flag-only diagnostic. Nothing here is a publication.
